capsicum__bacterial_spot: Greasy dark spots with pale centre and dark edge plus water-soaked fruit spots; no powder, fuzz or mosaic.
capsicum__healthy: No spots, fuzz, curl or wilting; all symptom features low.
chilli__cercospora: Round spots with grey centre and dark brown edge (frog-eye); no powder, no curl or stunting; bacterial leaf spot not separable from text.
chilli__healthy: Flat green leaves with no spots, powder, curl, stunting or insects.
chilli__murda_complex: Upward/inward curl, stunting, tiny crinkled new growth with thrips/mites/whitefly; spots and powder absent.
chilli__nutritional_deficiency: Yellowing/interveinal chlorosis or purpling without spots, powder or insects; leaf curl only mild.
chilli__powdery_mildew: White powder on leaf underside with defoliation; no grey-centred spots, no curl.
potato__early_blight: Dry angular ringed target spots on older leaves, no water-soaking and no white growth.
potato__healthy: No ringed or water-soaked spots, no white growth, stems upright.
potato__late_blight: Water-soaked spots turning purple-black, white growth underneath, stem rot, in cool humid weather, spreading in patches; no rings.
tomato__bacterial_spot: Small water-soaked spots with yellow halo, scabby fruit spots, no rings and no fuzz; spots smaller than early blight.
tomato__early_blight: Large spots with concentric bull's-eye rings and yellow edge on older leaves; not water-soaked, no fuzz.
tomato__healthy: No ringed, water-soaked, haloed spots or mould; all symptoms low.
tomato__late_blight: Fast spreading water-soaked black lesions with white growth in humid weather, no rings; stems and fruit rot.
tomato__leaf_mold: Pale spots on top with olive mould underneath on lower leaves in humid conditions; no rings.
tomato__mosaic_virus: Light/dark green mottling and puckered new leaves; no spots or fuzz, curl only minor.
tomato__septoria_leaf_spot: Many small grey-centred spots with dark margin and tiny black dots on lower leaves; no concentric rings.
tomato__spider_mites: Pest: fine stippling and webbing under leaves with tiny mites; no fungal signs.
tomato__target_spot: Spots with concentric dark rings and grey-brown centre, sunken fruit pits; resembles early blight, bacterial spot early on, distinguished weakly by pinpoint start and grey centres.
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl_virus: Severe stunting, yellowing and downward curl with whitefly; no spots or mottling-dominant pattern.
okra__alternaria_leaf_spot: Dark round spots each with a clear yellow halo; not grey-centred (Cercospora) or large tan-centred (Phyllosticta).
okra__cercospora_leaf_spot: Grey centres with dark edge, angular spots and sooty growth underneath; Alternaria has yellow halos instead.
okra__phyllosticta_leaf_spot: Large tan/pale thin centres, no yellow ring, no sooty underside; Alternaria has a halo, Cercospora has sooty growth.
okra__downy_mildew: Purplish-white fuzz only under the leaf below yellow patches in cool wet weather; spots are not the main sign.
okra__healthy: No spots, curling, yellow veins, powder or stunting.
okra__leaf_curly_virus: Whole vein network yellow, upward curl and stunting with whiteflies; no spots or fuzz.
rice__healthy: No spots, scorch, yellowing, stripes or stunting.
rice__rice_blast: Spindle spots with grey centres and brown edges (not banded from leaf tip), also node/neck lesions, in humid weather.
rice__leaf_scald: Tan and brown banded scorch starting at leaf tips and edges; blast has grey-centred spindle spots.
rice__rice_stripes: Pale/whitish long stripes and mottling with twisting; tungro gives overall orange-yellow leaves.
rice__rice_tungro: Orange-yellow leaves from the tip with stunting and few tillers; no white stripes (rice stripe).
rice__rice_leaffolder: Leaves folded lengthwise with a caterpillar inside and white scraped streaks; generic insect damage lacks folds.
rice__insect: General leaf-feeder damage (holes, scraping, hispa/thrips) without the lengthwise fold of leaf folder or the yellow-orange stunting of tungro.
sugarcane__healthy: Green leaves, no yellow midrib, pustules, stripes or stunting.
sugarcane__mosaic: Pale yellow stripes/mottle across the blade of young leaves; yellow leaf disease yellows the midrib instead.
sugarcane__redrot: Leaves orange then yellow with reddish cane interior with white patches when split; no pustules or stripes.
sugarcane__rust: Orange-brown pustules on leaf underside with spots joining into dead patches; the viruses and red rot have none.
sugarcane__yellow: Yellow midrib with top leaves drying from the midrib, stunted/bunchy top; mosaic gives stripes, red rot red cane.
wheat__septoria: Tan-brown blotches following veins with black dots, on lower leaves in humid weather; no powdery pustules.
wheat__stripe_rust: Narrow lines of yellow powdery pustules along the leaf in cool humid weather; Septoria gives blotches.
banana__black_sigatoka_disease: Black streaks along veins with NO yellow halo (yellow Sigatoka has grey-centred spots with yellow ring); spreads faster.
banana__yellow_sigatoka_disease: Oval spots with grey centre and yellow ring; black Sigatoka lacks the halo.
banana__panama_disease: Oldest leaves yellow first, dry edges, reddish streaks inside stem, no slimy ooze (Moko: youngest first, ooze).
banana__moko_disease: Youngest leaves collapse first, slimy ooze and dark fruit pulp (Panama: oldest leaves first, no ooze).
banana__bract_mosaic_virus_disease: Pink-reddish spindle streaks on pseudostem/bunch stalk and mosaic on bracts; no leaf spots or wilt.
banana__insect_pest_disease: Insect itself visible with tunnels, ooze holes, honeydew or scars; not a spot or streak pattern.
banana__healthy_leaf: No spots, streaks, wilt or pests; all symptom answers are NO.
mango__anthracnose: Brown spots/shot-holes on leaves and black fruit spots, not angular or water-soaked, no white powder.
mango__bacterial_canker: Water-soaked, angular, raised spots with yellow halo and gum ooze; anthracnose spots are brown shot-holes.
mango__die_back: Twig dries from tip downward with browned wood and gum; few leaf/fruit spots.
mango__powdery_mildew: White wipe-off powder on panicles and young leaves with purplish curling; sooty mould is black.
mango__sooty_mould: Black coating that flakes off over sticky honeydew; no white powder or true spots.
mango__cutting_weevil: Weevil cuts young pink leaves off at base; no galls (gall midge makes galls, midge maggots).
mango__gall_midge: Galls on leaves, buds failing to open, tiny midge maggots; no leaf cutting.
mango__healthy: No spots, powder, soot, galls or cut edges; all symptom answers NO.
groundnut__early_leaf_spot: Flat dark-brown spots with yellow halo, larger than late leaf spot, no raised pustules.
groundnut__late_leaf_spot: Smaller, nearly round black rough spots on underside, little halo, no pustules.
groundnut__rust: Raised orange-brown powdery pustules (underside) rather than flat spots.
groundnut__nutrition_deficiency: Yellowing/patchy field pattern with no spots, pustules or fungal signs.
groundnut__healthy_leaf: No spots, pustules or yellowing at all.
maize__blight: Long cigar-shaped lesions crossing veins, merging into big dead areas; no pustules.
maize__gray_leaf_spot: Narrow rectangular lesions stopped by veins; no pustules.
maize__common_rust: Powdery cinnamon-brown pustules on both leaf sides, not lesions.
apple__apple_scab: Olive-green velvety spots, rough black fruit spots, no purple edge, no swelling.
apple__black_rot: Frogeye: purple edge with tan centre, tiny black dots, firm banded fruit rot.
apple__cedar_apple_rust: Swollen yellow-orange spots with red border and black dots; juniper nearby.
apple__healthy: No spots on leaves or fruit.
grape__black_rot: Reddish-brown leaf spots with black dots; single berries turn black and shrivel.
grape__esca_(black_measles): Tiger stripes between veins, spotted cracking berries, dark wood.
grape__leaf_blight_(isariopsis_leaf_spot: Late-season dull red-brown spots on older leaves; whole cluster collapses.
grape__healthy: No spots, stripes or berry damage.
pest__aphids: Soft tiny clusters with honeydew and curled leaves; leafhoppers jump and are wedge-shaped, thrips are slender with silvery streaks, mites leave webbing.
pest__army_worm: Caterpillars in large numbers stripping leaves and marching; cutworm is solitary and cuts at the base, borers hide inside stems.
pest__corn_borer: Caterpillar inside the stem with dead heart and shot-holes in folded leaves; no marching mass, not cut at ground level.
pest__cutworm: Plants cut at ground level by a night-feeding caterpillar hiding in soil; armyworm feeds on leaves in groups, mole cricket has shovel legs.
pest__flea_beetle: Small beetle that hops and leaves many tiny round shot-holes; caterpillar holes are larger and ragged.
pest__gall_midge_dasineura: Maggots inside mango flower stalk with no visible hopper or heavy honeydew; mango hopper is visible, wedge-shaped, with sooty mould.
pest__leafhopper: Green wedge-shaped, moves sideways on leaf underside, hopper burn at edges; aphids stay soft in clusters, planthopper sits at the plant base in rice.
pest__mango_borer: Tunnels and excreta in mango shoot or branch with wilting tips; plain dieback shows no tunnels or insect.
pest__mango_hopper: Wedge-shaped hoppers crowd mango flower panicles with honeydew and sooty mould; gall midge damage is from maggots inside the stalk.
pest__mango_leaf_cutting_weevil: Snouted beetle notching or cutting young mango leaf tips, cut pieces under tree; shoot borer tunnels inside the shoot.
pest__mango_seed_weevil: Grub ends up in the stone of mango; fruit fly maggots feed in the soft pulp.
pest__mole_cricket: Cricket-like insect with big shovel front legs digging in soil and cutting seedlings; cutworm is a caterpillar.
pest__oriental_fruit_fly: White maggots in soft pulp of ripe or fallen fruit; seed weevil grub is in the stone.
pest__planthopper: Hopper burn in round patches with insects at rice plant base and honeydew; stem borer gives single dead hearts, leaf folder gives folded leaves.
pest__red_spider_mite: Fine webbing and yellow stippling under leaf from tiny red mites; thrips leave silvery scars without webbing.
pest__rice_gall_midge: Silver onion-leaf tube shoot from a midge maggot; stem borer deadheart is a dry shoot that pulls out.
pest__rice_leaf_folder: Leaf folded lengthwise with caterpillar inside and white scraped streaks; stem borer is inside the stem, planthopper burn dries patches from the base.
pest__rice_stem_borer: Dead heart pulling out easily or white ear with larva inside rice stem; gall midge gives silver tube, planthopper gives patches.
pest__rice_water_weevil: Flooded rice field with white leaf scraping and root feeding by larvae, stunting; no stem or leaf rolling.
pest__thrips: Tiny fringed-wing insects with silvery streaks and upward curl; aphids are soft and sticky, mites leave webbing.
pest__white_grub: Fat C-shaped whitish grub in soil eating roots, plants pull out easily; wireworm is thin and hard, cutworm cuts stems above ground.
pest__wireworm: Thin hard shiny tan larva boring seeds, roots and tubers; white grub is fat and C-shaped.
